account:
Today seems quiet, with no clear evidence of anything unusual. During my morning market walk, several residents had no news; others said the baker had been carrying a sack of wheat at the bakery. That sounds consistent with baking, though I have not verified what the wheat was for. I kept my noon appointment at home and returned to the office for town accounts. The treasury contained 128 emeralds, which I left untouched.

The main uncertainty was my three o'clock tea appointment. The appointment book named only a neighbour at a dockside cottage on the east bank. The secretary took the book and investigated the cottages and warehouse but reported that nobody could identify the host and several cottages had not answered. I had no invitation with me to clarify it. I therefore came to the cottage at road point (16, -60, 105), where I found the neighbour waiting near the open door. I greeted them for tea just before three and asked about the docks; I have not yet heard their reply. Their presence suggests I may have found the intended host, but they have not confirmed that yet. I know of no hidden purpose behind the appointment or the secretary's unsuccessful inquiries. I am due back at the office at 16:30.
